name: is-and-is-not

checks.name: is text that differs only in case

source: conditions.md, answer tests: is is true when the answer is this one value, isNot when it is a settled answer other than this one. Text compares with case: decided by a person.

name: one-of-lists

checks.name: isOneOf with one item that matches
isOneOf with one item that does not match
isOneOf with an item that starts with the answer
isOneOf with an item that is a part of the answer
isNotOneOf with one item that matches
isNotOneOf with an item that starts with the answer

source: conditions.md, answer tests: isOneOf is true when the answer is one of these values, isNotOneOf when it is a settled answer that is none of them. Whether a one-item list is allowed is the linter's rule, so the evaluator reads it as written.

name: false-flag
source: conditions.md, rules: a boolean false is a settled answer.

name: missing-answer

checks.name: section question in a section with no answers

source: conditions.md, rules: every test except isSettled is false when the question has no settled answer, before any negation. isNot on an unanswered question is false.

name: deferred-answer
source: domain-model.md: a Value is a settled answer unless it is Deferred or empty. conditions.md, rules: a settled answer is not deferred.

name: empty-answers

checks.name: empty text is not a settled answer for isSettled true
empty list is not a settled answer for isSettled true
list of only empty strings is not settled
list of only empty strings is not a settled answer for isSettled true
list with one non-empty item is settled
list with one non-empty item is not unanswered

source: conditions.md, rules: a settled answer is not deferred and not empty. domain-model.md: a Value is a settled answer unless it is Deferred or empty. A list is settled when it has at least one non-empty text item: decided by a person.

name: list-answer

checks.name: is an item of the list
isOneOf with an item of the list
isSettled true beside is on an item

source: domain-model.md, Value: a List is a list of text, held by command and multiple variables. conditions.md lists no test that compares a list: list tests are not supported yet, decided by a person. Only isSettled applies to a list answer.

name: list-test-values

checks.name: isOneOf with a list second, and the text first matching
isOneOf with a list and isSettled true
isSettled true with a text test that holds

source: conditions.md has no list operator, so a test value that is a list, or an item of isOneOf or isNotOneOf that is a list, makes the test false: list tests are not supported yet, decided by a person.

name: value-kinds

checks.name: text true is not the flag true
text true is not the flag true, isNot
flag true is not the text true
flag true is not the text true, isNot
text true is the text true

source: domain-model.md, Value: Text and Flag are different variants, so different kinds are different values. FORMAT.md: the Text deferred differs from the Deferred kind.

name: question-ids

checks.name: bare name reads the same section
bare name does not read the plan
bare name does not read another section
bare name with no answer in the section, though the plan has one
own section prefix reads the same section
an unknown section has no answer

source: conditions.md, syntax: a bare name is a question in the same scope as the condition, and plan.<name> is a plan variable. domain-model.md, Question: the id is <scope>.<name>.

name: plan-scope

checks.name: bare name in the plan scope reads the plan
bare name in the plan scope does not read a section

source: domain-model.md, Question: scope is plan or a section id. A bare name is read in the scope of the condition, and the scope of a plan variable's condition is plan.

name: all-clauses
source: conditions.md, syntax: all is a list of clauses that must all be true. The first check is the example in the Syntax section.

name: no-clauses
source: conditions.md, section conditions: no includeIf means always included, and all is a list of clauses that must all be true. An empty condition holds, as no includeIf holds: the neutral rule.

name: tests-in-one-answer

checks.name: two tests that contradict each other

source: conditions.md, answer tests: several tests in one answer must all hold. domain-model.md: the same rule. A contradiction is a lint error, so the evaluator reads it as written.

name: section-clause

checks.name: a section that is off, enabled false
a section that is off, enabled true
a section that is on, enabled true
a section that is on, enabled false
a section missing from the switches, enabled true
a section missing from the switches, enabled false

source: 0050-section-switch.md: a section clause holds when the section's switch equals enabled. The switch is on when absent, so a section missing from the switches, including an unknown id, is on.

name: no-switches
source: 0050-section-switch.md: the switch is on when absent. Nil switches mean every section is on.

name: section-clause-scope

checks.name: the id is not read in the scope, off section
the id is not read in the scope, on in the scope key
the section of the scope itself

source: 0050-section-switch.md: a section clause names a section id as written, with no scope prefix. Domain-model reading of Switches: section id to on.

name: section-clause-in-plan-scope
source: 0050-section-switch.md: a section clause names a section id as written. A plan scope condition is the same.

name: section-clause-ignores-answers

checks.name: an answer review.enabled true does not turn the switch on
an answer review.enabled true leaves the off switch off
a settled answer in an on section does not matter
a section with no answers at all is read by its switch
a section with no answers at all, off

source: 0050-section-switch.md: the switch is outside the questions and the answers. A stored answer named enabled is an ordinary answer.

name: answer-test-ignores-switches

checks.name: an answer in a section that is off still matches
an answer in a section that is off still fails a wrong value
a bare name in a scope that is off
a plan answer with every switch off
an empty answer in a section that is off is unsettled
an empty answer in a section that is off, isNot

source: 0050-section-switch.md: the evaluator tests answers by the answers alone, so a switch never changes an answer test. Settled answers: 0035-settled-and-deferred-answers.md.

name: section-clause-with-questions

checks.name: a question clause and a section clause both hold
the question clause holds and the section clause fails
the question clause fails and the section clause holds
the section clause comes first and fails
the section clause comes first and holds
the section clause fails between two question clauses
every clause holds, in a mix
two section clauses and the second fails
one section tested for both values

source: conditions.md, condition: a condition holds when every clause holds, whatever the kind. 0050-section-switch.md: a section clause is one clause of the list.
